thread:
maya: Quick one-pager idea: 'Sentry — SLAs & Deploy Lanes' for field. Goal: 1 page, sales-facing, includes 3 deploy modes, 2 SLA tiers (Standard / Enterprise), security checklist, inbound routing triggers, and webinar CTA. Need copy + quick benchmark narrative. Anyone taking?

simon: I'll take SLA + positioning. can we make the Enterprise tier call out 99.9% p99 latency under reserved capacity?

ajay: For benchmarks: 8–15ms p95 hosted (small models) vs 5–8ms on dedicated with batching. Cost note: prefix caching cuts token cost ~20–30% on chat workloads. I can sketch numbers.

marco: Add: KMS + HSM integration, VPC peering, SOC2/ISO comments, audit log retention options. Also mention optional air-gapped package.

olivia: Sales asks: routing triggers -> MQL if >$X/mo usage estimate, or mentions security/regulatory words (HIPAA / PCI). CTA: invite to 30-min 'secure inference' webinar + field demo.

maya: Love it. Let's keep copy snackable. Two variants: (A) Executive one-pager (single-column summary) (B) Field one-pager with checklist + routing. I'll mock both.

simon: For SLA language: "99.9% availability SLA for Dedicated; 99.5% for Hosted with best-effort region fallback." short, no legalese.

ajay: Technical callouts we should include: quantization profiles (8-bit / 4-bit), autoscale burst to handle spikes, prefix cache, model-variant fallback for graceful degradation.

maya: Draft outline:
- header + 2-line value prop
- deployment modes (bullets + icons)
- SLA snapshot (bulleted tiers)
- security & compliance highlights
- benchmark snapshot (latency & cost deltas)
- inbound routing triggers + next-step CTA

olivia: For routing rules, propose:
- MQL if estimated monthly spend > $10k OR mentions "data residency" / "SOC2" / "HIPAA"
- field alert to enterprise sales + solutions eng

marco: Also include checkbox for customer-managed keys and audit log retention 90 / 365 days options.

maya: Can someone draft the benchmark narrative copy: 2 short bullets: 1) latency improvements, 2) cost savings with caching / quantization. Ajay?

ajay: On it. Will write 2 bullets and attach numbers. Expect draft tomorrow EOD.

maya: Great. I'll assemble 2 layout options + sample CTA text. target to have PDFs + PNGs for sales by Fri.

launch-bot: reminder: Design assets due in 48h (via #design-requests). :bell: 

olivia: I'll prep the webinar invite language and a slide for inbound routing flow.

simon: Once maya posts drafts I'll do a quick copy pass.

maya: Thanks all. If anyone has example customer quotes we can add a 1-liner. tagging @olivia @marco

olivia: I'll pull 2 quotes from recent POC notes.

marco: sending SOC2 blurb to maya in DM.

maya: 👍 will update thread when I post the drafts.
